plan.thesis: A quantitative risk assessment turns scenario frequencies and probabilities of death into one person's individual risk, a population's societal risk and a test of whether a further measure is reasonably practicable. Associate owns HOW OFTEN AND WHAT IS ONE PERSON'S RISK, Professional owns HOW MANY AT ONCE, Expert owns IS A FURTHER MEASURE REASONABLY PRACTICABLE AND WHAT DOES THE ENGINE NOT KNOW. Each capstone grades only its own tier's question. The suggested tier split was kept: the engine's own structure (event trees and IR, then PLL, FAR and F-N, then ALARP and cost-benefit) argues for it.

tiers.beginner: Associate: frequencies, event trees and individual risk. m01 what a QRA answers, units, where Pd comes from (the H4 seam), the refusals; m02 general event trees, branch sums and the tolerance, pooling; m03 the flammable release tree, conditional delayed ignition, the split, Table 4.5 and what it rests on, forgetting a branch; m04 LSIR, contributions, the PB definition, Appendix 6.B from its Pd onward; m05 IRPA, hours over 8760, one place at a time, the vulnerability factor; m06 the transect, contours (a presentation rule), what IR does not say, the capstone brief. Digest sections 1 to 14.
tiers.intermediate: Professional: societal risk. m01 PLL; m02 FAR from PLL and the H1 identity; m03 the F-N curve, N or more, the step function, the area identity, reading it wrongly, no published worked example; m04 criterion lines, the Dutch line and the Bevi points, corners, exceedance ranges, the worst ratio; m05 the single R2P2 point, a caller line, touching and the state words; m06 the Fd fractions (transcription only, never graded) and the capstone brief. Digest sections 15 to 24.
tiers.advanced: Expert: ALARP and cost-benefit. m01 the three regions, workers and public, a threshold belongs to the lower band, the snap, the R2P2 box; m02 the benefit, VPF, injuries, the checklist example and its rounded verdict; m03 year-end present values, the two HSE conventions, the ICAF counted undiscounted; m04 the DF, strictly greater, the largest reasonably practicable cost, the DF sweep; m05 what the engine does not know; m06 ordering measures, the ALARP note, when the numbers are not enough. Digest sections 25 to 33.

evidence.$comment: H2's lesson: a formula or constant checked for transcription only carries no graded answer. The position for every graded quantity, read from FINDINGS-qra.md and re-measured in the digest.
evidence.event tree frequencies: exact arithmetic; the engine's oracle checks every tree in exact Fractions; oracle_check.py replays both Associate trees through the oracle's own tree walker exactly. Every ignition probability AND the flash fire / explosion split are STATED in the prompt, because the Table 4.5 cells and the 0.6 / 0.4 preset are single transcriptions
evidence.LSIR and IRPA: exact sums of stated inputs (PB 6.1, 6.2); hours over 8760 from lopa.js HOURS_PER_YEAR; every Pd stated; no vulnerability factor in any graded field
evidence.PLL and FAR: exact arithmetic; the FAR base is checked bit for bit against safetyStats.fatalAccidentRate (a SHARED plant of the base was caught)
evidence.F-N frequency, criterion ratio, exceedan: PB eq. 6.6 'N or more' as the engine's declared reading (the PB's own introduction says 'more than N'); NO published worked F-N example exists, so the curve is self-consistency only (oracle brute force, a 200 001 point grid route, the area identity); the criterion side IS published: the Bevi points lie on the PB line (a SHARED plant of C was caught by them) and the R2P2 point is printed. Graded as the engine's declared convention, never presented as a published reproduction
evidence.cost to benefit ratio, ICAF, largest rea: the checklist worked example reproduces (a SHARED DF plant was caught by its 93,000), the R2P2 margin reproduces, and seven independent assertions cover every present value including an exact identity with cashflow.ts npv; oracle_check.py replays each in exact rationals and by the closed-form annuity
evidence.never graded: a band, state or verdict word on its own; any Table 4.5 lookup or the 0.6 / 0.4 preset; any Fd fraction or factor (the SHARED clothing-factor plant stayed green); a contour crossing distance (a presentation rule, its SHARED plant stayed green); anything through the H4 functions (toxicPlumeGridPointRisk, thermalFatalityTransect, poolFireFatalityTransect); the PB Appendix 6.B chain; a vulnerability factor

history.position: THE ENGINE HAS ONE PIECE OF DEVELOPMENT HISTORY AND THE COURSE DOES NOT TEACH IT. FINDINGS-qra.md section 9 records six fail-opens (preset names walking the prototype chain) found and closed before #230 merged; it is provenance. The digest shows the engine's CURRENT behaviour (such a name is refused, section 3) and never frames former behaviour; structure.py and digest_prose.rules.mjs refuse any key, title or heading that reads as history.

scopeSeams.H4 consequence: OWNS source terms, dispersion, radiation, overpressure and every probit dose calculation (merged as nextgen #177, 20261006_h4_consequence_*). H5 takes Pd and every frequency as STATED inputs; the three engine functions that call H4 are named and never taught. gate_vocabulary.py confines the H4 words (probit, dose, dispersion, plume, radiation, heat flux, overpressure, release rate and the rest) to sentences that name the seam, symmetric with H4's own gate; gate_capstone_leak.mjs direction 7 keeps H5's graded values off H4's and direction 11 keeps every H4 graded answer out of every H5 text.

scopeSeams.LOPA and SIL: OWNED BY H3 lopa. Named only at the seam; 'SIL', 'PFDavg', 'IPL' and 'LOPA' confined to the seam lessons.
scopeSeams.API 521 point-source radiation and setba: OWNED BY FC1 and FC5. Never used; gated.
scopeSeams.NPV mechanics: OWNED BY the EC courses. The canonical year-end present value is used only inside the gross disproportion test and the discounted ICAF; 'NPV' and 'IRR' are never used.
